## TotemVanillaTweaks 0.1.23

### Traditional Chinese-first localization

- Adds complete English, Traditional Chinese, and Spanish resources for the
  module-owned player-facing strings.
- Keeps `zh_tw` as the preferred fallback language while retaining the existing
  Observer protocol, production Screen reconstruction, and input suppression.

Minecraft 26.2 · Fabric · Java 25 · requires TotemCore 0.7.16 or newer within
the 0.7.x compatibility line. Nexus integration targets TotemNexus 0.3.13.
